image_description: A close-up view of a large, blue-grey cylindrical plastic barrel situated outdoors on a gravel surface next to a wooden fence and a small evergreen bush. The barrel features horizontal reinforcing ribs. The top inlet and downspout connection are cropped out of the frame.
